7.4 Diagnostic trouble code definition
A ‘Diagnostic trouble code’ defines a unique identifier (shown to the diagnostic tester) mapped to a ‘Diagnostic event’ of the Dem module. The Dem provides the status of ‘Diagnostic trouble codes’ to the Dcm module (refer to chapter 7.11.2).
